name: Utility incomer connection interface
aliases: switchgear Switchboard source and bus interfaces
summary: Identifies the utility-side incoming switching point and its bus interface.
description: Identifies the utility-side incoming switching point and its bus interface. A source and bus arrangement shows how incoming supplies and outgoing circuits can be connected. Breaker and tie positions determine which sections are energized and whether sources can become electrically paralleled.

In a switchgear lineup with two incomers and a bus tie, the single-line arrangement helps the engineer identify normal supply paths and which loads change source during a transfer. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Utility feeder” at the input and “Utility-to-bus connection” at the output. Connection rules depend on the network agreement.

Keep normal positions, transfer limits, source independence and protection-zone boundaries visible. An arrangement drawing explains connectivity; the permitted switching sequence needs a separate approved scheme. The functional block is an independent explanation of this named application. Equipment-specific ratings, terminal connections and operating conditions must be established in the project documentation.
